'''Goh's Panpour''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのヒヤップ''' ''Go's Hiyappu'') is the fifth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Unova]] [[region]] and his eighty-third overall.

==In animation==
===History===
===={{aniseries|JN}}====
[[File:Goh and Panpour.png|thumb|left|250px|Panpour and Goh]]	
In ''[[JN065|Thrash of the Titans!]]'', [[Goh]] encountered and caught {{p|Panpour}} while visiting [[Opelucid City]].

In ''[[JN073|Grabbing the Brass Ring!]]'', Goh uses Panpour in a group with {{TP|Goh|Cinderace}}, {{TP|Goh|Raichu}}, {{TP|Goh|Grookey}}, and {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Pansear}} to help motivate the brass of a {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Falinks}} when it got split up. Initially, they had difficulty finding a sync, but after a few tries and Panpour steered along with Pansear, the group finally manages to unite.

In ''[[JN084|An Adventure of Mega Proportions!]]'', Goh used Panpour whilst on [[Mega Island]] to keep [[Ash's Lucario]] cool in the vicinity of lava. Using Rain Dance, Goh took the opportunity to run away with Lucario and try to find {{Ash}}. During the escape and with the help of Cinderace, Goh managed to capture a {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Camerupt}}. After reaching a safe location, Goh called back Panpour to its {{i|Poké Ball}}.

In ''[[JN107|Big Brother to the Rescue!]]'', {{TP|Professor Cerise|Yamper}} had Panpour use its {{m|Water Gun}} attack on [[Goh's Heracross]] to snap him out of its smitten trance over Goh's {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Lilligant}}, although this only worked for a brief time before Heracross was smitten by {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Alcremie}}'s scent.

In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', Panpour attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure. After that, it posed for a group photo with Goh, Ash, and the others.
{{-}}

===Personality and characteristics===
As first seen in ''[[JN070|Take My Thief! Please!]]'', Panpour is often seen alongside {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Pansear}} in the [[Cerise Laboratory]]. This link between the two is seen again in ''[[JN073|Grabbing the Brass Ring!]]'', when Panpour relies on Pansear to get his bearings on his quest to help the {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Falinks}} brass and during mealtime where the two join the queue together.
{{-}}
